subject.title: [Feature]: Goal continuance — per-turn goal context + QA continuance scenarios

question: Should active session goals be injected into every agent turn as bounded user-role context and covered by goal-continuance QA, with current-turn-only strip/replay guarantees before merge?
rationale: This is a model-visible prompt behavior change across all active goal sessions, and the open implementation PR shows that the exact metadata/replay contract needs maintainer intent before this issue can close.

options.title: Adopt after PR repair
options.body: Keep the linked PR as the implementation path, but require the generated goal line to be stripped from historical/user-visible replay and covered by focused tests before merge.

options.title: QA-only first
options.body: Add goal-continuance scenarios that expose the current gap before deciding whether automatic active-goal injection is the right prompt contract.

options.title: Defer automatic continuance
options.body: Keep goals as explicit `/goal` and tool state for now, accepting that users may need to prompt later turns manually.

recommendation.title: Adopt after PR repair
recommendation.body: Keep the linked PR as the implementation path, but require the generated goal line to be stripped from historical/user-visible replay and covered by focused tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the core goal surface and opened both the issue and linked implementation PR, so he is the clearest routing owner for this product contract.
